<thought>We need a template that describes the SN2 substitution of an aryl chloride (halide) by a tertiary amine, forming a C‑N bond and breaking a C‑Cl bond. Using the valid functional‑group names, we can search the template catalog for templates that break a “halide” and form a “tertiary amines”, with the appropriate bond changes. Once we obtain the template ID, we will apply it to the target molecule to get all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CCl)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["tertiary amines"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-Cl"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
